verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no global hotkey and no quake-style dropdown window in Alacritty. The CreateNewWindow keybinding works only inside the app, the `alacritty msg create-window` IPC is a building block a user would have to bind through their OS or window manager, and AlwaysOnTop is an adjacent window-level setting. None of these is a summon/dropdown capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can summon the terminal instantly with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window
